slide.heading: How information moves
slide.lead: Atkinson and Shiffrin proposed separate stores in 1968; information can be lost from each store.
points: Sensory register → STM: attention selects sensory information for short-term memory (STM); unattended information is lost.
Within STM: maintenance rehearsal repeats information. Without rehearsal, it may be lost through displacement or decay.
STM → LTM: prolonged rehearsal transfers information to long-term memory (LTM). Retrieval brings information from LTM back into STM.
